At least he left. 
There’s some misunderstanding between us now, but there is no reason for me to clear it, right? 
Whatever, now that he’s gone I can enjoy my coffee
*ping*
Huh? That’s weird. My machine started working even though I didn’t even touch my phone. Maybe it’s bugging out or something. 
Whatever, I was gonna make a coffee anyway. 
The question is, what am I going to do next?
